## Cite this audit

If this article or its executable evidence is useful in your work, please cite
the complete twelve-part audit:

> Elnashef, Bashar. *HOPE Under the Microscope: Independent Reproduction,
> Audit, and Extensions*. Version 1.0.0, 2026.

```bibtex
@software{elnashef2026hope,
  author  = {Elnashef, Bashar},
  title   = {{HOPE} Under the Microscope: Independent Reproduction, Audit, and Extensions},
  year    = {2026},
  version = {1.0.0},
  url     = {https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope},
  note    = {Independent executable 12-part audit of HOPE v1}
}
```

Machine-readable records: [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/v1.0.0/CITATION.cff)
and [CITATION.bib](https://github.com/basharelnashef/hope-under-the-microscope/blob/v1.0.0/CITATION.bib).
Please cite the original HOPE paper separately when referring to its method or
claims.
